# Australian Dog Lover

> > Your guide to dog news, books, events, and expert advice for Australian dog enthusiasts.

Australian Dog Lover is a digital magazine dedicated to dog lovers across Australia, featuring curated news, monthly book club selections, training guides, wellness advice, and a comprehensive calendar of dog events and conferences. The site combines community engagement through competitions and book clubs with practical resources on dog behavior, enrichment, health, and pet industry insights.

## Key Topics

- Dog Lovers Book Club
- Dog training
- Dog behavior
- Dog enrichment
- Dog books
- Pet health
- Australian dog events
- Dog-friendly products
- Canine wellness
- Dog stories
- Rescue dogs
- Dog accessories
- Eco-friendly pet products
- K-9 therapy
- Puppy training

## Core Pages

- [Australian Dog Lover](https://www.australiandoglover.com): Homepage for Australian Dog Lover digital magazine with news, reviews, and expert advice.
- [DOG NEWS | Australian Dog Lover](https://www.australiandoglover.com/p/dog-news.html): Curated archive of dog news, reviews, and insights from Australian pet industry.
- [COMPETITIONS | Australian Dog Lover](https://www.australiandoglover.com/p/competitions.html): Win free dog products and services from top Australian brands via giveaways.

## Dog Lovers Book Club

- [Dog Lovers Book Club - March 2026](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2026/03/dog-lovers-book-club-march-2026.html): March 2026 book club featuring Amy Curran's behaviour guide and rescue stories.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - February 2026](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2026/02/dog-lovers-book-club-february-2026.html): February 2026 top dog books featuring Andrew Daddo, Bluey, and training guides.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - Jan 2026](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2026/01/dog-lovers-book-club-jan-2026.html): January 2026 picks on canine science, button training, and children's books.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - Christmas 2025](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/11/dog-lovers-book-club-christmas-2025.html): Christmas book club featuring K-9 bravery, mysteries, and holiday family fun.
- [November 2025 Dog Lovers Book Club: Join the Fun!](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/10/november-2025-dog-lovers-book-club-join.html): November book club with Jeremy Clarkson, Steven Rowley, and sensitive dog guides.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club | October 2025](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/09/dog-lovers-book-club-october-2025.html): October 2025 selections on courageous K-9s and human-dog bonds.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - September 2025](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/08/dog-lovers-book-club-september-2025.html): September 2025 featuring dog separation anxiety guides and therapy dog work.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - August 2025](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/07/dog-lovers-book-club-august-2025.html): August 2025 picks on canine nutrition, pet loss, and dog behaviour.
- [Dog Lovers Book Club - July 2025](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2025/07/dog-lovers-book-club-july-2025.html): July 2025 book club featuring The Dogist and puppy training guides.

## Dog Health & Wellness

- [Stemming the Pet Obesity Crisis](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2026/03/stemming-pet-obesity-crisis.html): Behind-the-scenes look at pet obesity at Lort Smith Animal Hospital Melbourne.
- [How to Help Dogs Sleep Better](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2024/02/how-to-help-dogs-sleep-better.html): Guide to creating perfect sleep routines and finding best dog beds.

## Dog Training & Enrichment

- [5 Enriching Activities You Should Do With Your Dog Every Day](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2021/02/5-enriching-activities-you-should-do.html): Guide to daily enriching activities for dog exercise and mental stimulation.
- [Creating an Enriching Environment for Dogs](https://www.australiandoglover.com/2018/02/creating-enriching-environment-for-dogs.html): Guide to environmental enrichment and preventing boredom-related behavioural problems.
